## Manual vetting — TIC 24693554 (2026-06-18): FALSE POSITIVE → 0 discoveries

The single finalist does **not** survive light-curve inspection. Real TGLC sector-1 data downloaded from MAST (GAIA DR2 4633754320605028096, cam3-ccd3) and folded.

- **Signal sits in the noise.** Real folded depth **~727 ppm** (not the 4032 ppm BLS reported — 5.5× inflated); per-point noise ~1538 ppm → **per-transit SNR ≈ 1.8**. Off-transit control phases (0.25 / −0.25 / 0.35) give "depths" of the same order (0 / 755 / 655 ppm) as the transit phase. Only **3 transits covered in 27 d**, and one (epoch −1) shows **no dip at all**. Odd/even not constrainable (1 even transit).
- **LoRA mis-typed the star.** LoRA wrote "M-dwarf, R*~0.4, Rp~1.5–2 R⊕". Catalogue truth: **Teff=5585 K, R*=0.905 R☉, M*=0.99 M☉ — a Sun-like G star.** With R*=0.9 the BLS depth would imply Rp≈6.3 R⊕; the measured depth ~2.7 R⊕. The 2.3 h duration is also too short for a central transit at 9.57 d of a solar-density star (~3.5 h expected) → high impact or blend.
- **Blended deep EB.** The star's `candidate_num=1` (P=23.7 d) is a **16.5% eclipse** bled in from **TIC 50386052 at 0.7′** (≈2 TESS pixels). Signal B is independent of it (masking A leaves B unchanged) but has no real significance. `has_spoc=0`, single sector → unconfirmable.

**Lot 0617 result: 0 real discoveries.** Same pattern as 2026-06-12 (TIC 234968549/219338557): a postprocess "finalist" that dissolves under manual vetting. Failure mode here is doubled: BLS depth/SNR inflated in an artifact-rich field **+** LoRA assuming the wrong stellar type. Vetting script + 3-panel fold archived at `/tmp/vet_24693554_fold.png`.
